combo3.title: Cartoon Shade: Sorcerer of the Swamp into Horned Saurus
combo3.description: Two cards, going first or second. Sorcerer of the Swamp turns into Horned Saurus through Kaitoptera and Polymerization. Horned Saurus places Toon Kingdom from the Deck without activating it, so nothing is banished from the Deck, and as an Extra Deck monster it can't be Normal Summoned, which lets Cartoon Shade come out. Shade adds Toon Dark Magician Girl and is her Tribute. Going second, the bounce clears 2 cards and Horned Saurus and Toon Dark Magician Girl attack directly for 4000. Starting hand: Sorcerer of the Swamp, Cartoon Shade.

steps.text: Activate effect: Sorcerer of the Swamp in your hand. Reveal Horned Saurus in your Extra Deck.
Banish Kaitoptera from your Deck. Horned Saurus names it as a material, so it's a legal pick.
Special Summon Sorcerer of the Swamp. If it's used as material this turn, it can be treated as Kaitoptera.
Activate effect: Kaitoptera was banished.
Special Summon Kaitoptera from your banishment.
Activate effect: Kaitoptera in your Main Phase. This is the line's first add from the Deck, so it's the first spot for Ash Blossom or Droll & Lock Bird.
Add Polymerization from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Polymerization.
Send Sorcerer of the Swamp to the GY as material. It counts as Kaitoptera this turn.
Send Kaitoptera to the GY as material. It's a Dinosaur, which fills the second slot.
Fusion Summon Horned Saurus (2000 ATK).
Polymerization goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Horned Saurus's summon trigger. Place 1 Field Spell from your Deck face-up in your Field Zone. Placing isn't adding or summoning, so Ash Blossom can't stop it.
Place Toon Kingdom face-up in your Field Zone. It wasn't activated, so its 'banish the top 3 cards' clause doesn't apply. In the Field Zone its name becomes Toon World.
Special Summon Cartoon Shade from your hand. Horned Saurus is face-up and can't be Normal Summoned, which is all Shade's condition asks for. This summon doesn't start a chain.
Activate effect: Cartoon Shade was Special Summoned. Add 1 monster with 2000 ATK or DEF that can't be Normal Summoned/Set.
Add Toon Dark Magician Girl from your Deck to your hand. She has 2000 ATK and can't be Normal Summoned.
Tribute Cartoon Shade for Toon Dark Magician Girl's summon. She needs 1 Tribute while you control Toon World, and Toon Kingdom counts.
Special Summon Toon Dark Magician Girl from your hand.

Activate effect: Cartoon Shade was Tributed from the field. You control a monster with 2000 ATK, so target 2 cards on the field and return them to the hand. Going second, take 2 of your opponent's cards; going first, decline it.

Battle Phase: Horned Saurus can attack directly the turn it's Special Summoned, and Toon Dark Magician Girl can attack directly while your opponent controls no Toon monster. That's 2000 + 2000 = 4000 damage. Your Normal Summon is still unused, and Horned Saurus can also grant a Normal Summon of a Dinosaur or Dragon.

combo4.title: Cartoon Shade: Toon Bookmark Going-Second Bounce
combo4.description: Two cards, going second into a board with a face-up Extra Deck monster. Extra Deck monsters can't be Normal Summoned, and Cartoon Shade's condition checks both sides of the field, so your opponent's monster lets Shade come out. Shade adds Toon Dark Magician Girl before Toon Kingdom is activated, so Kingdom's banish can't take her. Tributing Shade for her bounces 2 cards, and she attacks directly the same turn. Starting hand: Toon Bookmark, Cartoon Shade.

steps.text: Activate Toon Bookmark.
Add Toon Kingdom from your Deck to your hand. Its text names Toon World, so Bookmark can add it. Hold it for now.
Toon Bookmark goes to the GY. From there it can take the hit if Toon Kingdom would be destroyed by a card effect.
Special Summon Cartoon Shade from your hand. Your opponent's Extra Deck monster is face-up and can't be Normal Summoned, and Shade's condition checks the whole field.
Activate effect: Cartoon Shade was Special Summoned.
Add Toon Dark Magician Girl from your Deck to your hand. Adding her before Toon Kingdom is activated keeps her out of the 3 cards Kingdom banishes.
Activate Toon Kingdom. When it's activated, the top 3 cards of your Deck are banished face-down. In the Field Zone its name becomes Toon World.
Tribute Cartoon Shade for Toon Dark Magician Girl's summon. Her summon doesn't start a chain.
Special Summon Toon Dark Magician Girl from your hand. Toon Kingdom stops your opponent from targeting her.

Activate effect: Cartoon Shade was Tributed from the field. Toon Dark Magician Girl has 2000 ATK, so target 2 of your opponent's cards, for example their Extra Deck monster and a Set card, and return them. An Extra Deck monster goes back to the Extra Deck. Nothing is destroyed, so destruction immunity and 'if destroyed' effects don't help them.

Battle Phase: Toon Dark Magician Girl has no 'cannot attack the turn it's summoned' clause. Your opponent controls no Toon monster, so she attacks directly for 2000. Your Normal Summon is still unused.

combo5.title: Cartoon Shade: Black Stone Playbook, Four Toons Going First
combo5.description: Going first, the Classic Analysis tab's Black Stone line with Cartoon Shade added. Toon Table of Contents adds Shade, Toon Dark Magician calls Toon Mermaid from the Deck so Shade has a monster that can't be Normal Summoned, and Shade adds Toon Dark Magician Girl and becomes her Tribute. End board: Toon Kingdom, Toon Bookmark in the GY, and four Toon monsters that can attack directly next turn for 8300. Starting hand: Toon Bookmark, Toon Table of Contents x2, The Black Stone of Legend, Toon Dark Magician.

steps.text: Activate Toon Bookmark.
Add Toon Kingdom from your Deck to your hand. Hold it until Toon Dark Magician Girl is in your hand.
Toon Bookmark goes to the GY, where it can later save Toon Kingdom from a destruction effect.
Activate Toon Table of Contents.
Add Cartoon Shade from your Deck to your hand. Its name contains 'Toon' (Car-toon), so it's a Toon card.
Toon Table of Contents goes to the GY.
Normal Summon The Black Stone of Legend.
Activate effect: The Black Stone of Legend.
Tribute The Black Stone of Legend as the cost.
Special Summon Red-Eyes Toon Dragon from your Deck. It's a Level 7 Red-Eyes monster.
Activate effect: Red-Eyes Toon Dragon. Special Summon 1 Toon monster from your hand, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
Special Summon Toon Dark Magician from your hand.
Activate effect: Toon Dark Magician. Choose to Special Summon a Toon monster from your Deck.
Discard the second Toon Table of Contents as the cost. Any Toon card works, including a second Cartoon Shade you couldn't summon this turn anyway.

Special Summon Toon Mermaid from your Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. It can't be Normal Summoned, so Cartoon Shade can now come out. Cartoon Shade itself isn't a Toon monster, so Toon Dark Magician can't call it.
Special Summon Cartoon Shade from your hand, using Toon Mermaid as the face-up monster that can't be Normal Summoned.
Activate effect: Cartoon Shade was Special Summoned.
Add Toon Dark Magician Girl from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Toon Kingdom. The top 3 cards of your Deck are banished face-down, and Toon Dark Magician Girl is already safe in your hand.
Tribute Cartoon Shade for Toon Dark Magician Girl's summon. Toon Kingdom counts as Toon World.
Special Summon Toon Dark Magician Girl from your hand.
Cartoon Shade's GY effect triggers, but going first your opponent has no cards to return. Decline it.

End of the line. Toon Kingdom stops your opponent from targeting your 4 Toon monsters and lets you banish a card from the top of your Deck instead of losing one to destruction. Toon Bookmark in the GY guards Toon Kingdom. Next turn, if your opponent controls no Toon monster, all four attack directly: 2000 + 2500 + 2400 + 1400 = 8300. Toon Mermaid costs 500 LP to attack.
